content:
[Intro]
[E5]

[Verse 1]
[E5]Here
I
lay,
still and breathless
just
like al-
ways.
Still I want some more.
Mir-
rors side-
ways,
who cares what's behind,
just
like al-
ways.
Still your passenger.

[Verse 2]
[E5]Chrome
buttons,
buckles and
leather surfaces.
These
and
other
lucky witnesses
now,
to calm
me.
This time won't you please

[Pre-Chorus]
[D5]drive
fas-
ter?

[Chorus]
[E5]Roll the win-
dows down, this
cool night air
is curious.
Let the whole
world look in,
who cares who
sees anything?
I'm your passenger,
I'm your passenger.

[Verse 3]
[E5]Drop these
down,
put them on me.
Nice cool
seats
there to
cushion your knees.
Now
to calm
me,
take me around again,
don't
pull o-
ver.
This time would you please

[Pre-Chorus]
[D5]drive
fa-
ster?

[Chorus]
[E5]Roll the win-
dows down, this
cool night air
is curious.
Let the whole
world look in,
who cares who
sees what tonight?
Roll these mis-
ty windows
down to catch
my breath, and then
go and go
and go. Just
drive me home
and back again.

[Break]
[E5]

[Interlude]
[E5]

[Verse 4]
[E5]Here
I
lay
just
like al-
ways.
Go, go,
go,
go,
go, go,
go,
go,
go.
Take me to the edge.

[Outro]
[D5]
[F5]
title: Passenger
tuning: E A D G B E
